n-k-k8-02.title: La mazwi ngawabani?
n-k-k8-02.topic: iindaba: ukunikela ingxelo nokuba ngubani ume ngasemva kwesibakala
n-k-k8-02.goal: Hlula phakathi koko inqaku leendaba elikuxela njengesibakala okanye uqikelelo lomntu, nalokho elikubala njengedatha, uze ubone isishwankathelo esiguqula isibakala sibe yinyaniso.
n-k-k8-02.material:
Funda eli nqaku lifutshane (elenziweyo).

□□시, 막차 1시간 늦춘다

□□시는 다음 달부터 시내버스 막차 시간을 1시간 늦춘다고 밝혔다. 시 관계자는 "이용객이 늘어난 노선부터 차례로 넓혀 갈 계획"이라고 설명했다. 지난해 밤 10시 이후 버스 이용객은 전년보다 12% 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다. 한 시민단체는 막차가 늦어지면 귀갓길 사고가 줄어들 것이라고 주장했다. 버스 노조는 운전기사가 부족해 계획대로 시행하기 어려울 것으로 보인다는 입장을 내놓았다.
n-k-k8-02.thinking.3: Ukuchaza umahluko usebenzisa amazwi enqaku ngokwalo
n-k-k8-02.prereq.1: Uyazi izenzi zokuxela ezifana ne-밝혔다, 주장했다, 설명했다
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha ZONKE izitatimende inqaku elizidlulisela kuphela njengengcamango okanye uqikelelo lomntu wangaphandle, ngaphandle kokuthi ziyinyani.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwisitatimende ngasinye buza: ngubani othethayo, kwaye ngaba sele kwenziwe, okanye kulindeleke kuphela?
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga izenzi ezigqibela izivakalisi: ezinye zithi 'zibhengeziwe' okanye 'zibaliwe', ezinye zithi 'zibambene' okanye 'isikhundla'.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.a: Esi sisixeko sibhengeza isigqibo saso ngeebhasi zaso; inqaku lixela oko isixeko sasikuthethile.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.d: Oku kuxelwa njengenani elibaliweyo, hayi njengombono okanye uqikelelo lomntu.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.e: Eli lelicebo lesixeko ngokwaso, elithethwe ngugosa laso; asingouqikelelo lomntu angaphandle.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.explain: Zombini b no-c ziqikelelo ezibangelwa liqela ('주장했다', '어려울 것으로 보인다는 입장'). Inqaku lixela ukuba bathe; alithi kuza kwenzeka ngokwenene. a no-e sisigqibo nelicebo lesixeko, kwaye d linani elibaliweyo.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi ushwankathela inqaku kwimigca emihlanu. Imigca emibini iguqula ibango okanye uqikelelo lomntu libe yinyani ecacileyo. Khetha omnye wayo.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.hint.0: Faka umgca ngezantsi komthethi wesivakalisi ngasinye senqaku, uze uhlole ukuba umgca ngamnye weshwankathelo uyamgcina.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khangela imigca apho uqikelelo luye lwaba ngumbono wento eyenzekileyo okanye eqinisekileyo.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.explain: Imigca yesi-3 neyesi-5 ayichanekanga. Kwinqaku iqela lembali lithi iingozi ziya kwehla, kwaye iyunyoni lilindele nje ubunzima. Imigca yesi-3 neyesi-5 ishiya abathethi ibonise ezi njengeenyani. Imigca yoku-1, owesi-2 nowesi-4 igcina umthethi.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.prompt: Omnye umfundi ubhala: '막차를 늦추면 사고가 줄어든다.' NgesiNgesi okanye ngesiKorean, cacisa ukuba kuphosakele ntoni kesi sivakalisi, usebenzisa amagama enqaku ngokwalo.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.hint.0: Fumana kwinqaku ukuba ngubani othe ngokwenene iingozi ziya kwehla.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.hint.1: Yitsho uhlobo lwentetho leyo (isigqibo, ukubala, okanye enye into) nokuba isivakalisi somfundi sayenza ntoni.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ndithe luqikelelo okanye ibango, hayi into eqinisekiswa yinqaku?
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.model.0: Inqaku lithi kuphela iqela lembali lithe (주장했다) iingozi ziya kwehla. Luqikelelo lwabo, hayi isiphumo eqinisekisiweyo, ngoko isivakalisi siyibeka njengenyani.

n-k-k8-05.title: Ngeyure yesithoba kunye neeyure ezi-2 nesiqingatha
n-k-k8-05.topic: intetho zexesha: 정각, 반, 정오, 자정; ungquzulwano ngaphakathi kweshedyuli
n-k-k8-05.goal: Fumana imigca emibini yeshedyuli yelayibrari yomhlangano engenakuba yinyani zombini, uyilungise, ugwebe ukuba isaziso sodwa sibonisa ukuba ngumgca onjani owaphosakala.
n-k-k8-05.material:
Isikolo sithumela le shedyuli kubazali yohambo lokulala. Yifunde yonke.

수련회 일정 안내 (6월 14일)
※ 정각 = ngqo ngeyure, 정오 = emini, 자정 = phakathi kobusuku.

n-k-k8-05.s.s1.explain: Imigca yoku-1 nowesi-2 iyaphikisana: ukuhamba ngo-9:00 ngohambo lweeyure ezi-2 nesiqingatha kuthetha ukufika ngo-11:30, hayi ngo-11:00. Imigca yesi-3 ukuya kwesi-6 iyahambelana (12:00 + iyure e-1; 1:00 + iiyure ezi-3 = 4:00; 6:00 + iiyure ezi-1.5 = 7:30).
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.prompt: Phinda ubhale UMGCA OMNYE kwiimigca ezimbini eziphikisanayo ngesiKorean (okanye ubhale ixesha elilungisiweyo ngesiNgesi) ukuze imigca emibini ivumelane.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.hint.0: Yongeza ubude bohambo kwixesha lokuhamba ubhale isiphumo.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.hint.1: Unokutshintsha ixesha lokufika, ubude bohambo okanye ixesha lokuhamba, kodwa zontathu kufuneka zivumelane.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ixesha lokuhamba, ubude bohambo nexesha lokufika ngoku ziyadibana?
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ilungisa ubude bohambo kunokuba ilungise ixesha lokufika.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.prompt: Umfundi uthi: 'Ngokucacileyo ixesha lokufika yimpazamo yokuchwetheza.' Ngaba kukhuselekile ukugqiba oko ngeshedyuli yodwa?
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.hint.0: Dwelisa amanani amathathu amele ahambelane uze ubuze ukuba esiphi isicatshulwa esibonisa ukuba silungile.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.hint.1: Buza ukuba luluphi ulwazi olongezelelweyo olunokukuvumela uqiniseke.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.a: Ewe: ixesha lokufika liza kokugqibela kwikhonkco, ngoko lelo lichwetheze kakubi.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.a: Ulandelelwano lwemigca alubonisi ukuba linani eliphi eliphosakeleyo; inani langaphambili linokuba yimpazamo ngokulula ngokunjalo.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.b: Ewe: abazali baya kuhlola ixesha lokufika, ngoko isikolo kufuneka sibe siphosile.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.b: Oko abazali bakuhlolayo akubonisi ukuba linani eliphi eliphosakeleyo.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.c: Hayi: imigca emibini sele ivumelana, ngoko akukho nto ifuna ukulungiswa.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.c: 9:00 kunye neeyure ezi-2 nemizuzu engama-30 yi-11:30, nto leyo engavumelani ne-11:00.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.d: Hayi: nawaphi na kumanani amathathu anokuba yimpazamo, ngoko isikolo kufuneka siqinisekise.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.explain: Isicatshulwa sibonisa kuphela ukuba amanani amathathu (ukuhamba, ubude bohambo, ukufika) awadibani. Nalo naliphi linokuba lilolo, ngoko isikolo kufuneka sithi leliphi eliqinisekileyo. Ukulungisa obhale kuyingqikelelo enengqiqo, hayi bungqina.

n-k-k8-01.title: Ngubani ongena ngaphakathi kwemida yesaziso?
n-k-k8-01.goal: Funda amagama amanani kwisaziso sokuzithandela esisemthethweni, wakhe amalungiselelo amaninzi okubhalisa anelisa yonke imida, uze uchaze ngamazwi akho ukuba kutheni umntu omnye osemgceni engena okanye engekho.
n-k-k8-01.material:
Idolophu ipapasha esi saziso. 만 N세 kuthetha 'oneminyaka eyi-N ngokubala kwezomthetho waseKorea'. Phatha onke amanani njengamanani aphelele.

청소년 봉사단 '이웃' 참가자 모집 안내
1. 대상: 만 13세 이상, 만 18세 미만 청소년
2. 팀 구성: 한 팀은 3명 이상 5명 이하
3. 하루 활동 시간: 최소 1시간 이상, 4시간을 초과할 수 없음
4. 활동 일수: 5일 미만
5. 인증서: 총 활동 시간(하루 활동 시간 × 활동 일수)이 10시간 이상이어야 받을 수 있음
n-k-k8-01.thinking.0: Ukufunda amagama emida: ngaba umda ubandakanya inani ngokwalo?
n-k-k8-01.prereq.0: Uyazi izibini 이상/이하 (zibandakanya inani) kunye ne-초과/미만 (aziyibandakanyi)
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.prompt: Isiqendu 3 sithi '4시간을 초과할 수 없음'. Ingaba umthathi-nxaxheba angasebenza iiyure ezi-4 ngqo ngosuku olunye?
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.hint.0: Yithi isiqendu ngokuvakalayo ngamazwi akho: yintoni ethintelweyo, iiyure ezi-4 okanye enye into?
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bona ngomoya umntu osebenza iiyure ezi-4 ngqo, ubuze ukuba isiqendu siyaphulwa na.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.a: Hayi: 초과 ibandakanya inani ngokwalo, ngoko iiyure ezi-4 ngqo azivumelekanga.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.a: 초과 ithetha 'ngaphezu kwe' kwaye ayibandakanyi inani. Yithelekise ne-이상, ebandakanya inani.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.b: Ewe: ukuthintelwa kukwiyure zizonke, hayi kwiiyure zosuku olunye.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.b: Isiqendu sithi sibhekisele ku-하루 (usuku olunye); izixa zizonke zinqunyelwe ngokwahlukileyo kwisiqendu 5.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.c: Ewe, kodwa kuphela kwiqela elinamalungu amahlanu.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.c: Akukho nto kwisiqendu 3 exhomekeke kubukhulu beqela; iqela lisesinye isiqendu.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.d: Ewe: iiyure ezi-4 ngumda ngokwawo; kuthintelwe kuphela ngaphezu kwezi-4.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.explain: 초과 ithetha 'ngaphezu kwe' kwaye ishiya inani, ngoko iiyure ezi-4 ziyavunyelwa kodwa ezi-5 hayi. 이상/이하 zibandakanya inani; 초과/미만 azibandakanyi.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.prompt: Gcwalisa ILUNGISELELO ELINYE lokubhalisa elivunyelwe sisaziso nelifumana isatifikethi. Yenza amalungiselelo ama-3 owahlukileyo anemiyaka emi-3 eyahlukileyo. a = ubudala (만 나이), n = ubukhulu beqela, h = iiyure ngosuku, d = inani leentsuku.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.0: Guqula isiqendu ngasinye esinamanani sibe ngumthetho omfutshane ngenani elinye phambi kokuba ukhethe amaxabiso.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ngobudala, emva koko khetha iiyure neentsuku kunye, kuba isiqendu 5 siyadibanisa.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.2: Vavanya ixabiso elisemgceni ngamnye (inani elincinci kunye nelona likhulu isiqendu ngasinye esibonakala sivumela) uze ufunde imiyalezo evelayo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Isiqendu 3: ubuncinane iyure e-1 kwaye hayi ngaphezu kweeyure ezi-4 ngosuku.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.fail.c5: Isiqendu 5: iiyure ngosuku x iintsuku kufuneka zibe zi-10 okanye ngaphezulu.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.explain: Imida: ubudala obuyi-13 bungena kwaye obuyi-18 abungeni; amaqela angama-3 nama-5 zombini ziyangena; iiyure ezi-4 ngosuku ziyangena; iintsuku ezi-5 azingeni; isixa esiyiyure ezili-10 ngqo siyanela. Amalungiselelo amaninzi ayafaneleka kuba isaziso sinika imida, hayi icebo elinye ngqo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Umhlobo wakho unemiyaka eyi-만 18세 ngqo namhlanje kwaye ufuna ukujoyina. Ngesivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini (ngesiKorean okanye ngesiNgesi), mxelele umhlobo ukuba angajoyina na kwaye kutheni, usebenzisa amazwi esaziso.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qala nquma isigqibo se-18 ngqo, emva koko ubize igama lesiqendu eliqinisayo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Thelekisa indlela i-이상 ne-미만 ezibaphatha ngayo inani elibhalwe ecaleni kwazo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ndithe ngokucacileyo ukuba i-18 ngokwayo ayivunyelwanga?
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ndisebenzise igama 미만 okanye ndachaza ukuba lishiya ntoni?
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Akanakujoyina. Isaziso sithi ngaphantsi kwe-18 (미만), kwaye 미만 ayibandakanyi i-18 ngokwayo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.prompt: Ilungu lomsebenzi liphendula imibuzo ngesaziso esifanayo. Imigca emibini iyiqonda gwenxa imida. Khetha omnye wayo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kumgca ngamnye, fumana isiqendu esihambelanayo negama lomda elisebenzisayo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.hint.1: Buza ngomgca ngamnye: ngaba elo gama lomda libala inani elibhalwe ecaleni kwalo?
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.explain: Imigca 2 kunye no-5 ayilunganga. '5명 이하' ibandakanya i-5, ngoko iqela labantu abahlanu liyavunyelwa. '10시간 이상' ibandakanya i-10, ngoko iiyure ezili-10 ngqo zifumana isatifikethi. Imigca 1, 3 kunye no-4 ifunda imida ngokufanelekileyo.

n-k-k8-03.title: Ukuvavanya inowuthi yegrama yomnye umfundi
n-k-k8-03.goal: Vavanya umthetho wegrama womnye umfundi ngokuchasene nemizekelo, gqiba ukuba uwulungisa njani, ubhale owakho umzekelo ochasayo.
n-k-k8-03.material:
Omnye umfundi wabhala oku encwadini.

  규칙: -(으)ㄴ/는데 = 'kodwa'. 앞의 내용과 뒤의 내용이 서로 반대일 때 쓴다.

Omnye umfundi uyakubuza: 'Ngaba umthetho wam uhlala uchanekile?' Wuvavanye.
n-k-k8-03.prereq.1: Unokubhala isivakalisi esilula sesiKorean kwixesha elidlulileyo okanye langoku
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.prompt: Sesiphi isivakalisi esingumzekelo ochasayo, apho -(으)ㄴ/는데 ichanekile kodwa iinxalenye ezimbini AZIPHIKISANI?
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.hint.0: Funda isivakalisi ngasinye uzame ukubeka 'kodwa' phakathi kweenxalenye zaso ezimbini: ngaba kuvakala kuqhelekile kuyo yonke imeko?
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuba inxalenye yesibini iyamangalisa okanye iyaphikisana nekokuqala, okanye yinxalenye elandelayo yebali nje.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.a: Apha inxalenye yesibini iyaphikisana noko 'intle' ikwenza ulindele, ngoko ihambelana nomthetho kwaye asingumzekelo ochasayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.b: Inxalenye yesibini iyamangalisa ngokunikwe yokuqala, ngoko ihambelana nomthetho.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.d: Isiphumo siphikisana nomzamo, ngoko sihambelana nomthetho.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.explain: Kwi-c inxalenye yokuqala inika indawo kuphela (ndaya e-mart) kwaye yesibini ithi ndifumene ntoni. Akukho nto iphikisanayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.hint.0: Gqiba ukuba uwulahle umthetho okanye utshintshe indlela oyibanga ngayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuba ukulungisa kwakho kusayicacisa imizekelo yokwahlukana nomzekelo ochasayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.a: Gcina umthetho njengoko unjalo, kuba izivakalisi ezininzi ze--는데 zihlukanisa.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.a: Umthetho othi 'rhoqo' uphulwa ngumzekelo omnye ochasayo ocacileyo, kungakhathaliseki ukuba zingaphi ezinye izivakalisi eziwufanelayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.b: Thi -는데 ihlala ihlukanisa kodwa inokubeka indawo yento elandelayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.c: Thi -는데 ikakhulu ibeka indawo, kwaye imizekelo yokwahlukana yimpazamo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.c: Izivakalisi zokwahlukana zisisiKorean esiqhelekileyo; umthetho mncinci kakhulu, kodwa awuphosakalanga ngokupheleleyo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.d: Thi -는데 ihlukanisa ekubhaleni, kodwa ekuthetheni ayihlukanisi.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.d: Akukho nto kwimizekelo exhomekeke ekuthetheni nokubhala.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.explain: Umthetho othi 'ukwahlukana kuphela' uphulwa ngumzekelo omnye ochasayo olungileyo. Ukulungisa kugcina oko kuyinyani (ukwahlukana kunye nokusetyenziswa) kwaye kwongeza ukusetyenziswa okulahlekileyo (ukubeka indawo yenxalenye elandelayo).
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.prompt: Bhala owakho isivakalisi sesiKorean nge--(으)ㄴ/는데 apho iinxalenye ezimbini AZIHLUKANISI. Emva koko wongeze inowuthi emfutshane (isiNgesi okanye isiKorean) ethi inxalenye yokuqala yenzela ntoni eyesibini.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.hint.0: Cinga ngexesha olibeke ngalo indawo phambi kokubuza okanye ukuxela into: phi, nini, ubone ntoni.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.hint.1: Emva kokubhala, zama ukubeka 'kodwa' phakathi kweenxalenye zakho ezimbini; ukuba ivakala ingalunganga, unomzekelo ochasayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba 'kodwa' ingalunganga phakathi kweenxalenye ezimbini zesivakalisi sam?
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba inowuthi yam ithi inxalenye yokuqala yenza ntoni (umzekelo inika indawo okanye isizathu sokubuza)?
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.model.0: 내일 시간이 있는데 같이 영화 볼래요? (Inxalenye yokuqala inika imeko, emva koko ndimema.)

n-k-k8-04.title: Isiqendu sokubuyisela imali esiguquguqukayo
n-k-k8-04.topic: imigaqo neemeko: umthetho, okungaphandle, okungaphandle kokungaphandle
n-k-k8-04.goal: Hlaziya isigqibo sokubuyisela imali njengoko izikhonkwane ezininzi zemigaqo yetikiti zivela, usebenzise izikhonkwane komnye umthengi, ucacise kutheni impendulo itshintshile.
n-k-k8-04.material: Mina uthenge itikiti lekonsathi kwiintsuku ezi-5 ezidlulileyo. Ikonsathi iseyintsuku ezili-10 ukusuka namhlanje. Akakwazi ukuya, ngoko namhlanje ufaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa kwemali. Imigaqo yetikiti ivela isiqendu ngesiqendu.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.prompt: Funda isiqendu ngasinye ngolandelelwano ukhethe eyona mpendulo ilungileyo ku-'Yimalini abuyiselwa ngayo uMina?' usebenzisa kuphela izikhonkwane ezibonisiweyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.hint.0: Sebenzisa kuphela izikhonkwane ozibonayo; ungaqikeleli okuza kulandela.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ngamaxesha onke, hlola imihla kaMina (iintsuku ezi-5 ukususela ekuthengeni, iintsuku ezili-10 ukuya kwikonsathi) ngokuchasene nesiqendu ngasinye esibonisiweyo.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Isiqendu sibeka umthetho ongenakho okungaphandle ukuza kuthi ga ngoku. 'Akukho kubuyiselwa kwemali' yimpendulo enengqiqo, nangona umfundi onenyameko ekhumbula ukuba okungaphandle kunokulandela.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Akukho nto kesi siqendu inika imali nayiphi na.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Esi siqendu asithi nto ngentlawulo okanye ngokubuyiselwa kwemali.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngesi siqendu songeziweyo, ungabuyiselwa mali yintoni uMina?
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.after: UMina ufaka isicelo iintsuku ezili-10 phambi kwekonsathi, nto leyo ingaphambi kwe-'7일 전', ngoko isiqendu ② sibonakala simnika ukubuyiselwa kwemali kususwa intlawulo. Kodwa isiqendu esitsha sisenokuyilinganisa.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Isiqendu ② kukungaphandle ('다만') ku-①, kwaye uMina ufaka isicelo iintsuku ezili-10 phambi kwekonsathi, ngoko ② sibonakala siyasebenza.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Intlawulo ye-10% iyasuswa, ngoko ayingokubuyiselwa kwemali ngokupheleleyo.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngazo zontathu izikhonkwane, ungabuyiselwa mali yintoni uMina?
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Isiqendu ③ songeza imeko yesibini kwi-②: isicelo kufuneka sifike ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezi-3 ukusuka ekuthengeni. UMina uthenge kwiintsuku ezi-5 ezidlulileyo, ngoko ② asisebenzi kwaye isiqendu ① siyagqiba: akukho kubuyiselwa kwemali.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uthenge kwiintsuku ezi-5 ezidlulileyo, nto leyo engaphezulu kweentsuku ezi-3, ngoko ② asisamsebenzeli.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Akukho siqendu sinika ukubuyiselwa kwemali ngokupheleleyo kwimeko yakhe.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ezi zikhonkwane zontathu sele zigqiba imihla kaMina; usenokuthi 'ngokweminye imigaqo', kodwa isigqibo sixhomekeke koko unako.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.reflect: Umthetho wokuqala wanika 'hayi', okungaphandle kwawenza 'ewe, kususwe intlawulo', kwaye isiqendu sokugqibela sasilinganisa loo ngaphandle kwakhona. Igama 다만 kunye 제2항은 ... 경우에만 liphawula amanyathelo anjalo. Funda zonke izikhonkwane phambi kokugqiba.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.prompt: Ngoku sebenzisa ezi zikhonkwane zintathu kuJun. UJun uthenge itikiti izolo. Ikonsathi iseyintsuku ezi-4 ukusuka namhlanje. Ufaka isicelo namhlanje. Angabuyiselwa mali yintoni?
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.hint.0: Hlola uJun ngemeko nganye ngexesha: umhla wokuthenga neentsuku eziseleyo phambi kwekonsathi.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.hint.1: Isiqendu esinika okungaphandle sisebenza kuphela xa zonke iimeko zaso zihlangene.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.a: Ukubuyiselwa kwemali kususwa intlawulo ye-10%, kuba wafaka isicelo ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezi-3.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.a: Isiqendu ② sinemeko yesibini: isicelo kufuneka sifike ubuncinane iintsuku ezi-7 phambi kwekonsathi.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.b: Akukho kubuyiselwa kwemali, kuba umhla wokugqibela weentsuku ezi-7 we-② udlulile.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.c: Ukubuyiselwa kwemali ngokupheleleyo, kuba uthenge itikiti izolo kuphela.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.c: Akukho nto kwizikhonkwane inika ukubuyiselwa kwemali ngokupheleleyo kwintengo yamva nje.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.d: Akukho kubuyiselwa kwemali, kuba ② yamatikiti athengwe iintsuku ezi-3 okanye ngaphezulu eziphelileyo kuphela.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.d: Isiqendu ③ sithi okuchaseneyo: ② isebenza kuphela ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezi-3 ukusuka ekuthengeni.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.explain: UJun uhlangabezana nemeko yeentsuku ezi-3 ye-③, kodwa isiqendu ② sikwadinga isicelo iintsuku ezi-7 phambi kwekonsathi, kwaye ziseleyo ezi-4 kuphela. Ngoko ② asisebenzi, kwaye ① sithi akukho kubuyiselwa kwemali.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.prompt: UMina uyabuza: 'Isiqendu ② sithi ndifumana ukubuyiselwa kwemali, ngoko kutheni impendulo yam itshintshile?' NgesiNgesi okanye ngesiKorean, cacisa kwizivakalisi ezimbini okanye ezintathu.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.hint.0: Fumana isiqendu esongezwe ekugqibeleni uthi yimeko eyongezelelweyo ayizisayo.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa loo meko nenani leentsuku ukusukela ekuthengeni itikiti kukaMina.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ndikhankanye imeko yeentsuku ezi-3 yesiqendu ③?
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ndithe kutheni umhla wokuthenga kukaMina ungayihlangabezani?
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.model.0: Isiqendu ③ sithi isiqendu ② sisebenza kuphela ukuba ufaka isicelo ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezi-3 ukusuka ekuthengeni. UMina uthenge kwiintsuku ezi-5 ezidlulileyo, ngoko ② asimsebenzeli kwaye umthetho osisiseko ① (akukho kubuyiselwa kwemali) uyabamba.
